root_cause: Order-gateway is producing HTTP 503 errors due to database connection rejections seen in logs. This points to issues in dependencies, likely caused by recent reference-db config tuning change CHG-4471 active since it aligns with error onset. Memory and latency on order-gateway instances are normal so no instance memory pressure is the cause.
summary: Escalated to on-call: Investigator found a current fault causing order-gateway HTTP 503 errors linked to reference-db config change but proposed no mitigation. The reviewer confirms no action to approve. Escalation is needed for dependency investigation and remediation.
